description: Defines the DVB Network Information Table (NIT) class with nested NetworkIterator class, including methods for accessing network descriptors and iterating over network entries.

classes.name: Thunder::Broadcast::DVB::NIT
classes.description: Represents a DVB Network Information Table with methods to access network descriptors and iterate over networks.

classes.name: Thunder::Broadcast::DVB::NIT::NetworkIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing network entries within the NIT, providing access to transport stream ID, original network ID, and descriptors.

methods.name: NIT::IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the NIT object contains valid data.

methods.name: NIT::NetworkId
methods.description: Returns the network ID associated with the NIT.

methods.name: NIT::Descriptors
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the descriptors in the NIT.

methods.name: NIT::Networks
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the network entries within the NIT.

methods.name: NetworkIterator::IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current network iterator position is valid.

methods.name: NetworkIterator::Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next network entry.

methods.name: NetworkIterator::TransportStreamId
methods.description: Returns the transport stream ID of the current network.

methods.name: NetworkIterator::OriginalNetworkId
methods.description: Returns the original network ID of the current network.

methods.name: NetworkIterator::Descriptors
methods.description: Returns an iterator over descriptors for the current network.
